title: structured-extraction case
description: One document (as text) and the fields that must be extracted from it.

input.description: the document text (OCR output, email body, PDF text); tokenise personal data first

tags.description: slices: format (clean, email, ocr), currency, language, document type

critical.description: e.g. high-value invoices and documents that must be rejected

metadata.description: e.g. original file name or page count

fields.description: expected values, null where the document has none
